tagline: Next prompts one click away, never sent for you

features.title: Suggestions
features.detail: After a finished turn, up to three one-line next prompts appear above the input, muted until the pointer is over one.

features.title: Click to fill
features.detail: A click puts the suggestion in the input for you to edit; nothing is sent.

features.title: Stays out of the way
features.detail: They clear when you send a prompt or a new turn starts, and a failed or interrupted turn shows nothing.

spans.text: Add a test for the empty case
